instruction:
Use Abaqus/CAE via the Command Line Interface (CLI) to build a contact analysis assembly from scratch:

1. Part-1 (Block):
   - 3D Deformable Solid, Extrusion
   - Sketch a rectangle from (0,0) to (20,20) in the X-Y plane
   - Extrude along the global Z-axis from Z=0 to Z=30 mm

2. Part-2 (Plate):
   - 3D Deformable Solid, Extrusion
   - Sketch a rectangle from (0,0) to (100,100) in the X-Y plane
   - Extrude along the global Z-axis from Z=0 to Z=5 mm

3. Property:
   - Material Steel: E = 210000 MPa, nu = 0.3
   - Create one Solid Homogeneous section and assign it to both parts

4. Assembly:
   - Instance both parts
   - Use Constraint > Coincident Point to align the center of the block bottom face (10,10,0) with the center of the plate top face (50,50,5)
   - Ensure the block sits directly on top of the plate with no gap and no initial penetration

5. Step:
   - Static, General, named Step-1, Nlgeom = ON

6. Interaction (key GUI operations):
   - Create a General Contact (Standard) or Surface-to-Surface Contact (Standard) interaction
   - Master surface: plate top face (outer surface, Z=5)
   - Slave surface: block bottom face (outer surface, Z=0 of the block instance)
   - Contact property: Frictionless, Hard Contact

7. Load:
   - Fully fix the bottom face of the plate (the face at Z=0 of the plate) with Encastre
   - Apply Pressure = 10 MPa on the top face of the block (the face at Z=30 mm), directed toward the block interior (downward, -Z)

8. Mesh:
   - Block: C3D8R, global seed size 3 mm
   - Plate: C3D8R, global seed size 5 mm

9. Job: Create Job-Contact and submit for solving.

10. Visualization:
    - Review contact pressure CPRESS contour
    - Review Mises stress contour

11. Save:
    - Model: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Contact.cae
    - Results: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Contact.odb
